figurative_meaning_en: to harm oneself or dig one's own grave
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এই কাজ করে নিজের জন্য কবর খোঁড়া করছে।
এমন সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া মানে নিজের কবর খোঁড়া।
example_sentences_in_english: By ignoring the advice, he's digging his own grave.
That decision is essentially digging your own grave.
note: This idiom draws from the universal imagery of death and self-destruction, common in Bengali folklore.
